blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
return query<UserRow>(sql);
findings.recommendation: CWE-89. Any account with the `support` role sends `GET /users/search?q=` with a term such as `x' UNION SELECT id, password_hash FROM users --` (2 to 100 characters, only trimmed at src/server.ts:13-14) and reads any table the database user can read; because `query` is called with no parameters, `pg` uses the simple query protocol, so stacked statements such as `x'; DROP TABLE users; --` run too. Bind the term as a parameter, as `src/db.ts` documents ("values go in `params`, never in `sql`"): `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%' || $1 || '%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", [term])`, escaping `%`, `_` and `\` in the term if they must match literally, and add a test that a term containing a quote returns no extra rows and no error.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term
